experimental_procedure: Typical Procedure for (2Z,4Z)-Methyl-2-(bromomethyl)-5-chloro-5-(3-chlorophenyl)penta-2,4-dienoate (5a) Br2 (1.60 g, 10.0 mmol) was added dropwise to a stirring solution of Ph3P (2.62 g, 10.0 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (20 mL) at 0 °C, followed by dropwise addition of a solution of 4a (2.87 g, 10.0 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (10 mL). The reaction mixture was stirred at room temperature for 15 min. Then the reaction was quenched by 20% Na2S2O3 solution (5 mL) and extracted with CH2Cl2 (3x30 mL). The combined organic phase was dried over Na2SO4 and evaporated under reduced pressure to give a crude product, which was purified by flash-column chromatography on silica gel (petroleum ether/ethyl acetate=20:1) to give 89% yield of 5a (3.12 g). (2Z,4Z)-Methyl-2-(bromomethyl)-5-chloro-5-(4-chlorophenyl)penta-2,4-dienoate (5a). Yellow solid, 3.12 g, 89%. mp 82.3-82.8°C.
